messages:
maya: FYI I'm rolling up nimbus-lite-v1 (fp16 -> q4x) onto staging for multilingual smoke. Quick pass shows a detokenization artifact when CJK and RTL scripts mix, plus a ~1.4 BLEU drop on zh->en. tagging eng-ml :eyes:
jiang: can you paste a repro sample?
maya: heres one from multilingual-scan: 
input: "明天 要退回 \u2014 ؟كيف الوقتاتة حالة"  # zh + arabic mixed
ref: "Back tomorrow  - what's the schedule?"  # simplified ref for clarity
output (nimbus-lite q4x): "Tomorrow I'm heading back \u2014 ؟كيف الوقتاتة the schedule."
notes: Arabic fragment preserved but surrounding punctuation glued to prior token, some characters doubled as insertion tokens.
tariq: can you diff token ids (prod tokenizer bundle vs nimbus tokenizer)? looks like an extra sentinel/unknown id snuck in previously for similar bugs.
maya: prod ids (first 12): [1203,4011,88,5099,10,3022,77,9003]
nimbus ids (first 13): [1203,4011,88,5099,10,3022,77,9003,65535]  # trailing 65535 sentinel before arabic block
jiang: 65535 is the legacy unk id from an earlier merge. Did the vocab remap script run during tokenizer build?
sam: also recall q4x changed embedding packing last week (packing-algo=v2) which shifts offsets in the quantized table; if embedding lookup clamps to unk on OOB address you get the sentinel.
maya: quick experiments: nimbus fp16 (no quant) => no detok issue. nimbus q4x with prod tokenizer bundle => detok improves (mismatch 1.8%) but not eliminated.
eval-bot: snapshot (multilingual-scan-1k):
- prod-model fp16: zh->en BLEU: 29.1, detok mismatch: 0.7%
- nimbus-lite-v1 fp16: BLEU: 28.8, detok mismatch: 1.0%
- nimbus-lite-v1 q4x: BLEU: 26.9, detok mismatch: 5.2%  :bug:
maya: big delta for q4x. Plan: (1) run q4x but keep embeddings fp16 to isolate embedding quantization, (2) run tokenizer bundle parity check and compare merge ops, (3) reproduce minimal embedding lookup on CPU to see address mapping. Sam/Tariq can you take (1)/(3)?
sam: I'll run embedding-lookup smoke and compare embedding-hash slices for the suspect ids.
tariq: I'll re-run tokenizer build with no merges and produce a canonical bundle for comparison.
jiang: I'll script a subtoken-boundary diff across CJK+Arabic heuristics and run it on the full eval set.
eval-bot: created ticket EV-2026-231 with artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/nimbus/v1/token-dumps/1769456789/ and /tmp/nimbus-detok-fail.log
maya: holding the canary on staging until we triage. ping @pager if rollback needed. thanks all.
